svg.aria-description: How mail reaches Buun Mail: 8 nodes, 7 connections. Mail for your domains, your IMAP mailboxes and your dissolve.email inboxes all come into one desktop app. The app files each message into a workspace and folder by the exact address it was delivered to, and keeps it on your computer, where agents can reach it over MCP.
svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: How mail reaches Buun Mail
svg.desc: How mail reaches Buun Mail: 8 nodes, 7 connections. Mail for your domains, your IMAP mailboxes and your dissolve.email inboxes all come into one desktop app. The app files each message into a workspace and folder by the exact address it was delivered to, and keeps it on your computer, where agents can reach it over MCP. Nodes: - Account: Your Cloudflare account - Your domains (MX to Email Routing), external - Mail gateway (Email Worker), function - External systems: Other mailboxes - IMAP mailboxes (Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail), external - dissolve.email (Disposable inboxes), external - Client side: Buun Mail on your computer - Router (Address to workspace), service - Local store (SQLite and .eml), database - Desktop app (Workspaces, folders), client - MCP agents (127.0.0.1 only), agent Connections: - Your domains to Mail gateway: catch-all - Mail gateway to Router (dotted): push - IMAP mailboxes to Router: collects - dissolve.email to Router: OAuth - Router to Local store (stored data line): files - Local store to Desktop app (stored data line): reads - MCP agents to Local store: searches
